_comment: Extra example phrasings per capability (English). DATA, not code: add or edit phrases freely, then run `node understand/build_manifest.mjs`. Aim for the different ways people really say one thing — short, chatty, polite, clipped, indirect. Keep held-out test phrases (tests/experiments/embeddings/*) OUT of this file.
